title: Roof Repair and Addition Tie-In in Gresham, OR
summary: In September 2026, French Roofing repaired a lifted ridge cap on a home in Gresham, OR and added new wall flashing where the roof meets a home addition. A temporary dry-in kept the house dry between work days.
scope: Repaired a section of lifted ridge cap
New wall flashing where the roof meets the home addition
Temporary dry-in so the house stayed dry between work days

photos.alt: New black wall flashing where a shingle roof meets the plywood wall of an addition in Gresham, OR
Aged shingles with a section of ridge cap lifted, before the repair
Temporary dry-in: underlayment held down over a roof opening between work days
